## 中文
**DSH 小秘书，DeepSeek Harness（dsh）插件。**替你盯着 GitHub 通知，也记住你交代的事（账单、续费、证件到期、生日）。它会查清楚哪些事已经结束、替你关掉，只把真要你处理
小秘书，DeepSeek Harness（dsh）插件。**替你盯着 GitHub 通知，也记住你交代的事（账单、续费、证件到期、生日）。它会查清楚哪些事已经结束、替你关掉，只把真要你处理的留给你。
支持 macOS / Windows / Linux，界面中英双语。设计见 docs/调研与设计.md，需求全景见 docs/需求清单.md。
### 能做什么
**GitHub 通知**：每 15 分钟拉一次全部未读通知，**查对象现在的状态**再判断，不看通知文字。
| 理由码 | 意思 |

| `merged` / `closed` | PR 已合并，或 issue / PR 已关闭 |
| `recovered` | 同一工作流在同一分支上后来通过了 |
| `superseded`

| 旧版本 tag 失败了，但后面的 main 或更新的 tag 已经通过 |
| `ref-gone` | 失败的那个分支已经删了 |
| `fork-upstream-schedule` | fo

rk 没有自己的提交，却在跑上游的定时任务，失败通知全是噪音；合成一件事：关掉这个 fork 的 Actions |
| `ci-failing` | 最近一次还是失败，交给你 |
| `review
-requested` / `mentioned` / `assigned` / `your-pr` / `commit-comment` | 交给你 |
几十条通知会合并成"事项"：同一工作流在同一分支上的失败算一件事，同一个 fork 的噪音也算一件事。
**手动交代**：在任何 DSH 对话里说一句，比如"护照 2027 年 3 月 10 日到期"或"每月 15 号交房租"。模型会整理出日期、重复方式和提前多久提醒，**DSH 弹出审批卡片让你核对，
你同意了才存**。到了提醒那天，它出现在待处理里。你说办了，这一期就关闭，下一期按周期自动出现。
默认提前量：证件 90 天，账单 3 天，生日纪念日 7 天，续费续保 7 天，其他 1 天。
**邮件**：在设置页添加邮箱（QQ、163、126、Gmail、iCloud，或自己填 IMAP 服务器），小秘书定时看收件箱里最近的未读邮件。**只读**：以只读方式打开收件箱，只看发件人、收件人
、标题和几个邮件头，不读正文，也不会把邮件标成已读。
| 理由码 | 意思 |

| `mail-to-you` | 直接写给你、没有群发或自动发送标记的邮件，可能在等你回复 |
| `mail-invite` | 会议或日程邀请，等你回应 |
| `mail-bill` | 标题

里有账单、还款、缴费、续费、发票之类的字眼（哪怕是群发的） |
| `mail-newsletter` / `mail-automated` | 群发邮件、系统自动邮件：折叠起来，不打扰你 |

### What it does
**GitHub notifications**: every 15 minutes it pulls all unread notifications and judges each one by
**the current state of what it is about**, never by the notification text.
| Reason | Meaning |

| `merged` / `closed` | The PR was merged, or the issue / PR was closed |
| `recovered` | The same w

orkflow later passed on the same branch |
| `superseded` | An old release tag failed, but main or a

newer tag has passed since |
| `ref-gone` | The failing branch has been deleted |
| `fork-upstream-s
chedule` | A fork with no commits of its own runs its parent's scheduled workflows; every failure is

noise, folded into one item: turn off Actions on the fork |
| `ci-failing` | The latest run still f

ails; handed to you |
| `review-requested` / `mentioned` / `assigned` / `your-pr` / `commit-comment`

u |
| `review-requested` / `mentioned` / `assigned` / `your-pr` / `commit-comment` | Handed to you |
Dozens of notifications fold into a few *items*: all failures of one workflow on one branch are one
item, and all noise from one fork is one item.
**Things you tell it**: in any DSH chat, say "my passport expires on 2027-03-10" or "rent is due on
the 15th every month". The model works out the date, the repeat and how early to remind you; **DSH s
hows an approval card with exactly what was understood, and nothing is saved until you approve it**.
On the reminder day the item appears on your list. When you say it is done, that occurrence closes
and the next one appears on its own schedule.
Default warning times: documents 90 days, bills 3, birthdays 7, renewals 7, everything else 1.
**Mail**: add a mailbox on the settings page (QQ, 163, 126, Gmail, iCloud, or your own IMAP server)
and the secretary looks at recent unread mail in your inbox. **Read-only**: the inbox is opened read
-only; only sender, recipients, subject and a few headers are read — never the body — and nothing is
ender, recipients, subject and a few headers are read — never the body — and nothing is marked read.
| Reason | Meaning |
| `mail-to-you` | Written to you directly, with no bulk or automated markers; someone may be waiting

|
| `mail-invite` | A meeting or calendar invitation waiting for your answer |
| `mail-bill` | The

subject mentions a bill, payment, renewal or invoice (even in bulk mail) |
[该节后续省略]
### What it will not do
- **It does not mark anything read on GitHub by default.** `markRead` starts as `shadow`: it records
which notifications it *would* mark read and touches none. Check `/mishu closed`, then switch to `o

n`. Items still on your list are never marked read.
- **Notification text never triggers an action.*

* Only verified state does.
- **Your own decision is not overturned by the same evidence.** Only new

er activity at the source re-opens the question.
- **Reopening something a rule closed counts as a c
orrection.** A rule that has closed at least 10 items and been corrected on more than 20% of them is

demoted: from then on its conclusions are shown to you instead of closing items.
- **It does not to
uch your mailbox.** Read-only: no bodies, no marking read, no deleting or moving, no sending.
